steps.name: Resolve Turbo SCM base
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ ! "$PR_BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "PR base SHA is missing or invalid" >&2; exit 1
fi
# On GitHub's PR merge commit (second parent: the PR head), the base
# it was merged into is its first parent. The event's base SHA can be
# older, and then main's later changes count as the PR's and widen
# the affected set.
second="$(git rev-parse -q --verify 'HEAD^2' || true)"
if [[ -n "$second" && "$second" == "${PR_HEAD_SHA:-}" ]]; then
  BASE="$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^1')"
else
  git cat-file -e "${PR_BASE_SHA}^{commit}" || git fetch --no-tags origin "$PR_BASE_SHA"
  BASE="$(git merge-base "$PR_BASE_SHA" HEAD)"
fi
echo "base=${BASE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Impact classification (shadow)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git diff --name-only "${TURBO_SCM_BASE}"...HEAD \
  | node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/impact-classifier.mts --base="${TURBO_SCM_BASE}" \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/impact-plan.json"

steps.name: DCO sign-off check
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Merge commits carry no sign-off of their own: the checked-out PR merge
# ref and an update-branch merge are made by GitHub. Only the commits a
# contributor wrote are checked. The list is read into a variable first so
# a failing rev-list fails the step instead of reading as zero commits.
commits="$(git rev-list --no-merges "${DCO_BASE}..HEAD")"
missing=0
while read -r sha; do
  [ -z "$sha" ] && continue
  author="$(git show -s --format='%an <%ae>' "$sha")"
  # On a variable rather than a pipe: an early `grep -q` exit would fail the
  # pipeline under pipefail and read as a missing sign-off.
  message="$(git show -s --format='%B' "$sha")"
  if ! grep -qiF "Signed-off-by: $author" <<<"$message"; then
    echo "::warning::missing or mismatched DCO sign-off on $(git show -s --format='%h %s' "$sha") (expected 'Signed-off-by: $author')"
    missing=$((missing + 1))
  fi
done <<<"$commits"
if [ "$missing" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "$missing commit(s) without a matching DCO sign-off. Fix with: git rebase --signoff ${DCO_BASE}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "All commits carry a matching DCO sign-off."

steps.name: Resolve the merge group base and gate scope
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# An unreachable merge-group base runs repo-wide; otherwise
# scripts/ci/affected-lanes.mts --main-gate decides. Root scripts and
# //# tasks stay scoped; globalDependencies and other shared inputs widen.
base="$GITHUB_EVENT_MERGE_GROUP_BASE_SHA"
if [ -n "$base" ] && ! git cat-file -e "${base}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then base=""; fi
# A workflow edit cannot change a package's test result.
scope="repo-wide"
tests="all"
if [ -n "$base" ]; then
  changed="$(git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD)"
  scope="$(node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/affected-lanes.mts --main-gate --base="$base" <<<"$changed")"
  lanes="$(node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/affected-lanes.mts --base="$base" <<<"$changed")"
  if [ "$lanes" != "--filter=*" ]; then tests="affected"; fi
fi
echo "merge group gate: ${scope}, workspace tests: ${tests} (base ${base:-none})"
{
  echo "base=${base}"
  echo "scope=${scope}"
  echo "tests=${tests}"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Plan workspace test shards
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
case "$EVENT_NAME" in
  pull_request) TESTS=affected; BASE="$PR_BASE" ;;
  *) TESTS="$MERGE_TESTS"; BASE="$MERGE_BASE" ;;
esac
shards='[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]'
if [ "$TESTS" = "affected" ] && [ -n "$BASE" ] && git cat-file -e "${BASE}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
  planned="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD |
    node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/dependent-tests.mts \
      --base="$BASE" --plan-shards=8)" || planned=""
  if [[ "$planned" =~ ^\[[0-7](,\ [0-7])*\]$ ]]; then shards="$planned"; fi
fi
echo "workspace test shards: ${shards}"
echo "shards=${shards}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Impact classification (shadow)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD \
  | node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/impact-classifier.mts --base="$BASE" --meaningful-out="$RUNNER_TEMP/impact-meaningful.txt" \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/impact-plan.json"

steps.name: S0 gate set
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/prune-stray-workspace-packages.mts
if [ "$SCOPE" = "affected" ]; then
  pnpm agent:check -- --base="$BASE" --external-workspace-tests
else
  pnpm run check:all
fi

steps.name: Workspace tests
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
case "$EVENT_NAME" in
  pull_request) TESTS=affected; BASE="$PR_BASE" ;;
  merge_group) TESTS="$MERGE_TESTS"; BASE="$MERGE_BASE" ;;
  *) echo "Unexpected event: $EVENT_NAME" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "$TESTS" in
  affected)
    # Changed packages run whole; their dependents run only the tests
    # whose import closure reaches a change. A missing base is an error.
    if [ -z "$BASE" ] || ! git cat-file -e "${BASE}^{commit}"; then
      echo "Merge-group base is missing or unreachable" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD |
      node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/dependent-tests.mts \
        --base="$BASE" --shard="$SHARD/$SHARD_TOTAL" --run --anon-profile=turbo-profile.json
    ;;
  all)
    printf '' | node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/dependent-tests.mts \
      --shard="$SHARD/$SHARD_TOTAL" --run --anon-profile=turbo-profile.json
    ;;
  *) echo "Invalid or missing merge-group test scope: $TESTS" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

steps.name: Decide whether the diff reaches packages, pins or submodules
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if ! git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^2 >/dev/null; then
  echo "HEAD is not a PR merge commit; running every check"
  echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
# Read root config at HEAD^1 too, so root-only edits stay off-path.
CHANGED="$(git diff --name-only HEAD^1 HEAD)"
LANES="$(printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/ci/affected-lanes.mts --base=HEAD^1)"
# ts-autocode surface and package-boundary inputs that live outside packages/.
PINS="$(printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -E '^(external/|tools/pins/|\.gitmodules$|scripts/test/ts-autocode-|scripts/bootstrap-siblings\.mts$|scripts/check-package-boundaries)' || true)"
if [ -z "$LANES" ] && [ -z "$PINS" ]; then
  echo "Only inert paths changed; skipping install, ts-autocode surface and production packages gate"
  echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Build affected images + live OCI config contract
steps.run:
set -uo pipefail
build() { node --no-warnings scripts/ci/build-release-oci-image.mts "$@"; }
build_one() {
  local id="$1"
  echo "::group::${id}"
  local ok=1
  if [ "$id" = "hobo-cli" ] || [ "$id" = "hobo-mcp" ]; then
    # Prerequisite base image: allow staging it even when only the
    # dependent image is affected (stage guard checks this list).
    HOBO_RELEASE_OCI_AFFECTED_IMAGE_IDS="${HOBO_RELEASE_OCI_AFFECTED_IMAGE_IDS} hobo-sdk" \
      build hobo-sdk --keep-candidate || ok=0
  fi
  if [ "$id" = "hobo-mcp" ] && ! docker image inspect hobo-cli:candidate >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    HOBO_RELEASE_OCI_AFFECTED_IMAGE_IDS="${HOBO_RELEASE_OCI_AFFECTED_IMAGE_IDS} hobo-cli" \
      build hobo-cli --keep-candidate || ok=0
  fi
  if [ "$ok" = 1 ]; then build "$id" --keep-candidate || ok=0; fi
  if [ "$ok" = 1 ]; then
    HOBO_RELEASE_OCI_CONTRACT=live HOBO_RELEASE_OCI_IMAGE_ID="$id" \
      pnpm exec vitest run scripts/test/release-oci-image-contract.test.ts || ok=0
  fi
  if [ "$id" != "hobo-cli" ] || [[ " $IMAGE_IDS " != *" hobo-mcp "* ]]; then
    build "$id" --cleanup-only
  fi
  echo "::endgroup::"
  if [ "$ok" = 0 ]; then
    echo "::error::release image ${id} failed"
    return 1
  fi
}
failed=()
for id in $IMAGE_IDS; do
  if [ "$id" = "hobo-mcp" ] || [ "$id" = "hobo-cli" ]; then continue; fi
  if ! build_one "$id"; then failed+=("$id"); fi
done
if [[ " $IMAGE_IDS " == *" hobo-cli "* ]]; then
  if ! build_one hobo-cli; then failed+=("hobo-cli"); fi
fi
if [[ " $IMAGE_IDS " == *" hobo-mcp "* ]]; then
  if ! build_one hobo-mcp; then failed+=("hobo-mcp"); fi
fi
if [ "${#failed[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "failed images: ${failed[*]}"
  exit 1
fi
